map.饲养密度能按经验随便定吗？: Can stocking density be set casually by experience?
map.不能。密度过高增加呼吸道病、啄癖与氨味，还超出粪污处理能力。应参考品种饲养手册与: No. Over-high density raises respiratory disease, pecking, and ammonia, and exceeds manure capacity. Determine by breed manual and local emission limits.
map.存栏和出栏是一回事吗？: Are stocking and off-take the same?
